_meta.source: Wikipedia bird phylogeny pages, using Stiller et al. 2024 where those pages identify that topology
_meta.policy: Generated clade memberships contain only named clade nodes. Ranked taxa such as Passeriformes are supplied by the ranked taxonomy and are never duplicated as clade nodes.
_meta.postOrderPolicy: Passeriformes species inherit their verified family-level intermediate clade path from clades.json.
